profile.description: Recommended low-TTFA server configuration for a 16-core Google Axion host. Every value was read from the qualification harness and the engine source, not from memory.

hardware.notes: GCP c4a-standard-16, no SMT. SVE/SVE2 are present at 128-bit but the engine has no SVE kernel path today.

requirements.kleidiai: vendored subset of ARM-software/kleidiai; SMMLA and BFMMLA both compiled and active
requirements.note: GIT_REV must be passed on the command line: a synced tree has no .git, so the binary cannot certify its own commit.

server.worker_affinity: contiguous core slices, worker 0 -> CPU 0-7, worker 1 -> CPU 8-15

precision.speech_decoder_weights: fp32 - QWEN_SD_INT8 is off by default and int4 measured slower on the first frame
precision.activations: fp32; int8 activations are quantized per call inside the int8 kernels
precision.gemm_backend: KleidiAI BFMMLA for bf16 matmat, SMMLA for int8 matmat, OpenBLAS sgemm for the speech decoder convolutions

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: MUST be set. Without it OpenBLAS idles by spinning and contends with the engine's own pool. Measured on this platform, same binary and bank, arms interleaved: first audio at concurrency 1 was 108 ms without it and 66 ms with it, and the bare arm was BIMODAL between the two, so one run lands on either and looks definitive. Beside it: 42,500 context switches per second against 12,000, and 7.9 cores busy against 7.2. At concurrency 4 the same lever is worth nothing (173 against 169 ms), because busy workers leave no idle time to spin through.

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: deliberately NOT set, and it must be ABSENT rather than merely unset by us. The engine binds OpenBLAS to the thread budget at startup, and qwen_blas_set_threads() returns immediately when this variable is present -- so an unrelated export in the operating shell silently replaces the thread split this profile was qualified with, for every stage and every load. It would also disable the opt-in per-load adjustment (QWEN_SERVE_BLAS / QWEN_SERVE_BLAS_BUSY), which is off by default.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: set it explicitly only to override the engine's own sizing, knowingly

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: reuses the request-independent prompt head; measured 9 of 13-79 positions on the production prompts

QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE.why: diagnostics; counters and timing never share a binary in a run that produces a number
QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE.revert: QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE=1 for the driver phase table

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: sub-tile the GEMM's n dimension so the microkernel's second height pass finds the packed RHS in cache. Measured on this platform: prefill p50 45.02 -> 42.87 ms and first audio 72.20 -> 70.20 across three paired rounds, output bitwise identical. 192 and 96 both measured WORSE than either 384 or 0, so smaller is not better.
QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.revert: QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK=0 restores one kernel call per slice

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: route the prefill projections through the native bf16 matmat instead of BLAS. On this platform it wins at every thread budget (-j1 2014 -> 1439 ms, -j16 310 -> 167). It is already the default where the matrix unit is real; pinned here so a change of default elsewhere cannot silently move this configuration.
QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.revert: QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT=0 returns to BLAS without a rebuild

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: generations a pool worker re-reads before parking on the condvar. 4096 was tuned on other hardware and costs 40 % of the Code Predictor here; 65536 measured CP 16.0 -> 9.6 ms/f and 491,320 -> 35,132 context switches. Higher buys nothing and 262144 at -j16 is worse.
QWEN_POOL_SPIN.revert: QWEN_POOL_SPIN=4096 for the previous value, 0 to park immediately

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: batch the speech decoder across slots. Measured +8.1 % throughput with first-audio p50 -8.9 % and p95 -6.1 % at concurrency 4, and the audio moves by one LSB in 32768 on 81 samples of 161,280. The server enables it by default; pinned so the profile records what ran.

qualification.workload: REALISTIC - a mixed-length text bank, 21 texts, audio p50 3.84 s per request. Short-text banks are an engineering inner loop and never a production figure.
qualification.speaker: ryan
qualification.notes: preferred_concurrency is 4 because at C=6 the realtime factor measured ~1.1: first audio still good, sustained realtime not. The band claims nothing above C=8. Topology and thread split were qualified on this host; the model named here is the base checkpoint the profile is exercised against, and a profile makes no claim about any particular checkpoint's audio.
